title: About
lead:
Less noise. More you.
That's Tranquil Haven Coaching.
body:
Tranquil Haven Coaching is a private, psychologically-informed coaching practice for women navigating emotional clarity, relationship challenges, and personal transformation.

Hi, I am Nina. I work with women navigating emotional clarity, relationship challenges, and personal transformation. My approach is grounded in psychological principles and ICF coaching, as well as my own lived experience of major life transitions, immigration, cultural change, and rebuilding life when things no longer feel familiar. I’ve been through the kinds of shifts where identity becomes unclear, relationships change, and life stops fitting the way it used to — and I understand that experience deeply.

Because of that, I genuinely understand my clients. I understand what it feels like when relationships change, identity becomes unclear, and the life you built no longer fits who you are becoming. When everything inside you is quietly asking for direction, but there is no clear manual for how to move forward (I’m still waiting for that one too).

I support clients through major life transitions — including relationship challenges, immigration, relocation, multicultural experiences, and questions of identity and emotional wellbeing — in a safe, affirming space.

This is for women who feel overwhelmed, emotionally tired, or quietly ready for a new chapter but unsure where to start. A calm, grounded space with no pressure to perform or have everything figured out — just room to slow down, breathe, and be understood.

As an ICF Member and psychology-informed coach, I offer confidential support during periods of change, loss, and new beginnings.

Sessions are online, so you can join from a private space where you feel safe, comfortable, and fully yourself.
note: Please note: Tranquil Haven Coaching provides coaching services only and does not provide psychotherapy, counseling, or mental health treatment.
